Requirement You have a captured soul or spirit fragment in your Static Cell.

Duration permanent

Bind the soul into your Rig. Your Rig permanently gains a +1 status bonus to attack rolls and to its class DC, and 5 additional Hit Points per level. You may take this feat's binding again each time you capture another soul; each binding after the first adds the same benefit and raises the Attention on you by one step. At Attention 1 the bound things notice; at 2 they follow; at 3 something comes for the Rig. The GM decides what, and when.
